name: Exatom
author: exatom

sections.description:
Exatom is a cookieless conversion tool to reduce form and check-out abandonment. You gain insights into all your forms — including dynamic forms — without manual tagging.

This plugin makes it easy to install the Exatom tags on your WordPress website and start tracking what matters most. Our plugin makes sure the tags are placed automatically on every page. No code editing required.

Features

  • Automatic placement of the Exatom Event tag on all pages
  • Conversion tag placement on selected thank you pages — just click to select
  • We’re cookieless and ISO27001 certified – no unnecessary data collection
  • Auto detection of forms and checkout pages

How we process your data

  • The Exatom platform is built with a digital privacy focus for your website visitors in mind, this from day one. Our cookieless Form Analytics tool offers website owners actionable insights on how their forms are performing without the need to show a cookie notice and invade your visitor’s digital privacy.
  • Read our data journey to learn more about how we process your data.
  • Terms of Service: https://exatom.io/terms-and-conditions/
  • Services Privacy Policy: https://exatom.io/services-privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the exatom folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins in WordPress admin.
  3. Go to Settings > Exatom.
  4. Enter your Client Code (and optionally your Conversion Code).
  5. Select your thank you pages for conversion tracking (optional).
  6. Click Save settings — the tags are now live.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Client Code?

Your client code is included in the tag documentation you received from Exatom. You can also find it in the Exatom admin panel > Setup > Tags.

Which pages should I select as thank you pages?

Select the pages visitors land on after submitting a form — for example a “Thank you” or “Request received” page. The Conversion tag will only be placed on those pages.

Is consent required?

No, Exatom is cookieless and only processes (anonymously) the IP address. However, please check with your legal team if your website requires consent. Read our data journey to learn more about how we process your data.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. All Exatom scripts are loaded asynchronously and do not block page rendering.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin removes its saved settings when it is uninstalled.
